question: Which of the following has the highest salinity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lake Van**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **Lake Van**

__
 
• **Lake Van, 330** has the highest salinity.
 
• Lake Van is the largest lake in Turkey.
 
• It is a saline soda lake, receiving water from many small streams that descend from the surrounding mountains. It is one of the world's few endorheic lakes (a lake having no outlet) of size greater than 3,000 square kilometres (1,200 sq mi)
 
• Despite the high altitude and winter highs below 0 °C (32 °F), high salinity usually prevents it from freezing.

 Great Salt Lake

• It is located in the northern part of the U.S.
 
• It is the largest saltwater lake in the Western Hemisphere.
 
• As it is endorheic (has no outlet besides evaporation), it has very high salinity (far saltier than seawater).
 
 
 
 

 Dead Sea
 238
 
 
 
• It is a salt lake bordered by Jordan in the east and Israel and the West Bank to the west.
 
• It is one of the world's saltiest bodies of water.
 
• This salinity makes for a harsh environment in which plants and animals cannot flourish, hence its name.
